verdict.rationale: Featurebase's core product is explicitly a public feedback portal with voting and a public roadmap, as directly stated in the docs ("Centralize insights to a single source of truth with a feedback portal... Let users vote on each other's ideas & show a public roadmap"). This is a marketing-page level description without independent hands-on corroboration of the portal UX itself. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the actual customer-facing portal experience, and details on customization/branding of the public portal.
